hierarchical_bootstrap: Resample three independent training checkpoints within each arm independently. Resample shared20 environment IDs with replacement identically across both arms for each replicate. Percentile95CI; no filtering or scenario-as-training pseudoreplication.
environment_seed_test: Exact two-sided sign flip over20 training-seed-averaged paired environment differences, all1048576 assignments, tolerance1e-12.
holm_family: Three primary lateTPS contrasts only; no secondary metric significance tests.
interpretation: Exploratory extension on an already observed shared panel, only3 independent checkpoints per arm. Conditional scenario p-values are not tests over a population of training seeds; no guaranteed or population significance claim.
